prompt: Create ONE neutral posture/contact master from the audited identity and any supplied essential prop authority. Businessman seated at same desk/chair, central blank working sheet exposed, pencil at rest front-right, two fixed paper stacks and cold cigarette, drawer closed with NO key; neutral face and hands at rest. Preserve identity, age, dot-shaped eyes (no anime eyes or enlarged irises), face/nose/ears, hair silhouette and colour, skin, costume colours and body proportions. No redesign, mirroring or extra limbs. Establish the specified camera and support arrangement; keep the complete contact group intact. Neutral soft upper-left daylight, without environment-colour spill. Use a restrained translucent neutral shadow touching actual ground supports, softly fading to zero alpha. Keep the floor itself transparent, with no pale painted island. No detached blob, dark oval, opaque floor or checkerboard. Preserve opaque subject interiors. 4:3, 2K native transparent PNG; no scenery, labels or diagram marks.
